definitions.explanation: Time off from work or school after the death of a relative, to attend the wake and funeral. Workplaces and schools set the number of days by how close the relative was.

examples.japanese: {忌引|きび}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{亡|な}くなり→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧、{三日間|みっかかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{忌引|きび}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother died, and I was given three days' bereavement leave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{忌引|きび}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Bereavement leave from school is not counted as an absence, so it doesn't affect grades.

notes:
Made of {忌|き} (mourning) + {引|ひ}き (withdrawing; びき by rendaku). Also written {忌引|きびき} without the き.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忌引|きび}き{休暇|きゅうか}: bereavement leave
- {忌引|きび}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take bereavement leave
- {忌引|きび}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧: to be off on bereavement leave

USAGE:
A typical company rule gives about a week for a parent or spouse, three days for a grandparent or sibling, and a day for more distant relatives.
